title: Set image of {{name}}

intro.Deployment: The pods are replaced as for any update. The change appears in the rollout history and can be rolled back.
intro.StatefulSet: The pods are replaced by the StatefulSet's update strategy. The change appears in the rollout history and can be rolled back.
intro.DaemonSet: The pods are replaced by the DaemonSet's update strategy. The change appears in the rollout history and can be rolled back.
intro.CronJob: Only Jobs started after the change use the new images; running Jobs keep theirs.
intro.Pod: Kubernetes lets a running Pod change only the images of its containers. The kubelet restarts each changed container with its new image.

invalid.spaces: An image reference cannot contain spaces.
invalid.tooLong: The image name is longer than 255 characters.
invalid.uppercase: The repository path must be in lowercase.
invalid.name: The repository path is not valid: use lowercase letters and digits, separated by “.”, “_”, “__”, “-” or “/”.
invalid.host: The registry host is not valid.
invalid.tag: The tag is not valid: up to 128 letters, digits, “_”, “.” and “-”, not starting with “.” or “-”.
invalid.digest: The digest is not valid: write it as sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal digits.

warning.latest: The tag “latest” can point to another image at each pull, so pods may run different versions.
warning.noTag: Without a tag the image “latest” is pulled, which can point to another image at each pull.

owned.intro: This Pod is managed by {{kind}} {{name}}: the controller would replace the Pod or ignore a changed image. Set the image in the {{kind}} instead.

mirror: This is a static Pod: the kubelet runs it from a manifest file on its node. Change the image in that file.
